name: fingerprint
description: Tests artifacts against fingerprint definitions and produces deterministic content hashes

options.name: json
options.description: Accepted as structured-output intent; run output is already JSONL

options.name: fp
options.description: Fingerprint ID, evaluated in CLI order

options.name: describe
options.description: Print the operator.v1 contract and exit

options.name: schema
options.description: Print the fingerprint.v0 JSON Schema and exit

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Print the same operator.v1 contract as --describe

commands.name: robot-docs
commands.description: Print paste-ready operating notes for agents

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Read-only health, capabilities, and triage diagnostics

commands.name: peek
commands.description: Inspect delimited row shape without emitting cell content

commands.name: materialize
commands.description: Project a matched extract section (XLSX header-anchored range, an HTML region or XML repeating records) into a deterministic CSV/JSONL/Parquet table plus a provenance sidecar; fails closed

commands.name: match
commands.description: Match files or directories directly (walk, blake3 hash, fingerprint) with no vacuum | hashbytes pipe; --view full|brief|delta

commands.name: infer
commands.description: Infer a fingerprint definition from example documents

commands.name: infer-schema
commands.description: Infer fingerprint fields from a document

commands.name: struct-check
commands.description: Check directory structure against pattern rules

0.meaning: all records matched or command succeeded

1.meaning: partial fingerprint result or unhealthy doctor

refusals.message: Child fingerprint references an unloaded parent
materialize: cannot read the input or write the output
materialize: the document does not match the fingerprint
materialize: more than one child fingerprint matches
materialize: the fingerprint has no extract with that name
materialize: no tabular projection exists for this extract type and document format
materialize: the range cannot be projected (empty or duplicate header, error cell, bad range)
materialize: the output or its provenance sidecar already exists; it is never overwritten

env_vars.name: HOME
env_vars.description: Home directory for config and witness fallbacks

side_effects.notes: Run and infer modes read artifacts and may write generated definitions or witness records; doctor and introspection are read-only.
